TUCK SHOP POS - SETUP ON THE SHOP COMPUTER
============================================

STEP 1 - Install Java (one time only)
--------------------------------------
Download and install "Temurin 17 JRE" for Windows from:
  https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?version=17
Choose the .msi installer, run it, click Next through the defaults.

STEP 2 - Copy this folder
--------------------------
Copy this whole folder to the shop computer, e.g. to:
  C:\TuckShopPOS\

STEP 3 - First run
--------------------
Double-click start-pos.bat
Wait for the black window to say "Tuck Shop POS is running."
Open a browser (Chrome/Edge) and go to:
  http://localhost:8080
Leave the black window open - closing it stops the program.

STEP 4 - Log in and change the default passwords immediately
----------------------------------------------------------------
  Owner login:   username: owner     password: owner123
  Cashier login: username: cashier   password: cashier123
Go to "Staff accounts" (owner only) and click "Reset password" for both
accounts. Pick passwords only you and your staff know.

STEP 5 - Make it start automatically after every reboot
------------------------------------------------------------
Double-click enable-autostart.bat (only needs to be done once).
Now if the computer restarts (e.g. after a power cut), the system comes
back on its own - no one needs to remember to start it.

STEP 6 - Let the owner check it from his phone
---------------------------------------------------
1. Make sure the shop computer and the owner's phone are on the SAME WiFi.
2. On the shop computer, open Command Prompt and type: ipconfig
   Look for "IPv4 Address", e.g. 192.168.1.10
3. On the phone's browser, go to: http://192.168.1.10:8080 (use the real
   number from step 2) and bookmark it.

STEP 7 - Barcode scanner (if you have one)
-----------------------------------------------
Just plug it in via USB. No setup needed - click into the barcode box on
the Billing page and scan; it works like a keyboard typing the code.

STEP 8 - Take a backup right away
--------------------------------------
Log in as owner, go to "Backups" in the sidebar, click "Backup now".
A backup also happens automatically every night. Check this page from your
phone every week or so and download a copy - that's your safety copy if
this computer is ever lost, stolen, or the hard drive fails.

STEP 9 - Note the License Device ID
-----------------------------------------
Log in as owner, go to "License" in the sidebar, and note down the Device
ID shown there. Send it to your system provider before the trial period
ends so they can issue your renewal key.

If anything doesn't work, contact your system provider with:
  - What you did right before the problem
  - Any error message shown (take a photo of the screen)
